proposed.text: In the Philippine floor area framework under PD 1096, what does PSO (Percent of Site Occupancy) multiplied by TLA (Total Lot Area) produce?

options.text: Total Allowable GFA, which determines the maximum floor area that can be constructed on a given lot
TGFA (Total Gross Floor Area), which includes all covered areas of a building
FLAR (Floor to Lot Area Ratio), a measure of density and land use efficiency

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: AMBF = TLA × PSO is the foundational formula for determining the maximum building footprint. This is distinct from FLAR (which controls total floor area across all floors) and GFA (which is the actual computed floor area). The AMBF limits horizontal coverage; FLAR limits total building volume.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096, Rule VII / Rule VIII (Allowable Areas)
